name: Cat photograph (Wikimedia Commons)
_note: Real 120x120 JPEG of a cat. Tests the raw_image path: with no vision adapter and no OCR configured the parser emits NOTHING. A placeholder is not content — it used to be embedded and stored like real text, so it came back in the top-k of every unrelated search. The parse is still recorded as skipped with reason 'no_vision_or_ocr_adapter', so the ingest reports '0 pages readable' instead of a clean success. With a vision adapter it would queue a vision call and emit a real caption; with OCR it would emit a paragraph of the transcribed text.
